niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces that feel calm, polished, and intentionally organized: light or softly toned surfaces, restrained contrast, clear section hierarchy, balanced spacing, polished icon/color accents, and layouts that look complete and thoughtfully grouped rather than noisy, fragmented, or visually harsh. Also values concise, supportive messaging and controlled emphasis over alarmist or overly aggressive presentation.

criteria.description: Prefers strong top-down organization with clearly separated sections, distinct grouping, and layouts that feel coherent, complete, and easy to scan.
Prefers a soft, calm, polished aesthetic with restrained contrast and reduced visual harshness or noise.
Prefers reassuring, conversational, help-oriented copy with concise framing rather than dense, procedural, or alarm-heavy wording.
Prefers polished iconography and accent usage such as color-coded or pastel icon tiles, friendly visual anchors, and cohesive accent styling that adds personality without feeling loud.
Prefers populated, fully realized screens with visible options, concrete controls, and interfaces that feel finished rather than sparse, empty, or under-specified.
